prompts.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: photographic homepage service-card preview for a real electronics retailer, intended for a coordinated set of eight images. Generate ONE standalone landscape photograph, approximately 3:2, not a collage or a webpage. Style: photorealistic commercial tabletop photography with believable physical geometry, tactile materials, subtle everyday imperfections, soft directional daylight from a large window out of frame, neutral light-gray stone counter, charcoal and silver products, a restrained teal accent. Camera: natural perspective with a 50mm lens feel, enough depth of field to clearly understand the subject. Composition: main objects well inside the central 80 percent, comfortable margins, designed to remain legible in a short, small mobile homepage card. Every object must be physically resting on a surface. No people, no hands, no arms, no body parts, no gloves, no human silhouettes or human reflections anywhere. No lettering, captions, watermark, fake branding, signage, or graphic overlays. Background is a softly blurred neutral studio/workbench, not an invented retail storefront. Avoid CGI sheen, plastic-looking metal, excessive bokeh, dramatic spotlights, neon glow, floating objects, and clutter. Primary scene: one modern black iPhone resting flat face-up diagonally on a compact charcoal anti-static work mat on the stone counter. Its switched-off black glass has a plausible spiderweb crack originating at one lower corner; most glass remains intact and reflections are soft. Show a realistic metallic side rail and intact phone silhouette. A single precision screwdriver with a muted teal handle and one small clear suction tool rest neatly beside the phone, not on top of it. Close three-quarter overhead view, phone occupies about 60 percent of the frame. Quiet, competent workshop mood, realistic crack texture rather than white decorative lines. This is a service image; do not add detached screens, exploded parts, sparks, cables plugged in, or any person.
